production.direction_en: The Matron seals herself behind a glass ward and floods the chamber with corrosive vapor.
production.music_direction_en: pre: bgm_tension (glass harmonics) | battle: bgm_boss_human (alchemist variation) | post: bgm_warmth (Kera stays)

commands.speaker: kera_voss
commands.text: I am staying to copy every page of the antidote archive.

commands.speaker: tilda_fen
commands.text: Iona and I will reopen the clinic. The patients need a door that stays open.

commands.speaker: iona_mist
commands.text: I will hang the lantern first. People should see the door before they need it.

commands.speaker: mahmut
commands.text: We will come back for you.

commands.speaker: kera_voss
commands.text: Bring the missing formula. I will bring the rest.

commands.speaker: jori_flint
commands.text: Oakhaven has no smith while I am down here. I am going home to hold the gate. Send word when something needs a door.

commands.speaker: fadyme_thought
commands.text: Weeks. Perhaps less. The words do not become kinder when repeated.
